annotations.title: Score a live website for AI-made design habits

description: Use when the user asks whether a website, landing page or app looks AI-generated or generic, wants a design critique of a live URL, or asks "does my site look like AI slop?". Fetches the page and checks 19 habits (purple-blue gradients, buzzword copy, glassmorphism, icon-card grids, template headlines, app-builder fingerprints and more), then returns a 0-100 score, a verdict, each habit found with the evidence and how to fix it, and the habits that were not found. It is a habit check, not an AI detector. Public http(s) pages only. Example: {"url": "https://example.com"}.

url.description: Public website address, for example example.com or https://example.com/pricing
